concepts.def: Y-shaped immunoglobulin produced by plasma cells; variable region binds specific antigen.
B lymphocyte with matching receptor proliferates after antigen binding (Burnet 1957).
Functional unit: glomerulus, Bowman's capsule, proximal tubule, loop of Henle, distal tubule, collecting duct.
High-pressure filtration at glomerulus; basement membrane retains proteins; filtrate enters Bowman's capsule.
Antidiuretic hormone from posterior pituitary; inserts aquaporins in collecting duct increasing water reabsorption.
Meiotic production of sperm in seminiferous tubules; takes ~74 days in humans; regulated by FSH and testosterone.
